items.source: This accessor is explicitly designed for user-declared properties and does not resolve technical properties on java.lang.Object or java.lang.Class. For unrestricted resolution, choose ReflectivePropertyAccessor instead.
items.translation: 此访问器专门设计用于用户声明的属性，不会解析 `java.lang.Object` 或 `java.lang.Class` 上的技术属性。如需不受限制的解析，请选择 ReflectivePropertyAccessor。

items.source: The default implementation considers any method as a candidate, even for non-user-declared properties on the Object base class.
items.translation: 默认实现会将任何方法都视为候选项，即使这些方法属于 Object 基类中非用户声明的属性。

items.source:
A property can be referenced through a public getter method (when being read)
or a public setter method (when being written), and also as a public field.
items.translation: 属性可以通过公共 getter 方法（在读取时）或公共 setter 方法（在写入时）引用，也可以作为公共字段引用。

items.source: Create a new data-binding property accessor for read-only operations.
items.translation: 为只读操作创建一个新的数据绑定属性访问器。

items.source: Create a new data-binding property accessor for read-write operations.
items.translation: 为读写操作创建一个新的数据绑定属性访问器。

items.source: Determine whether the given Method is a candidate for property access on an instance of the given target class.
items.translation: 确定给定的Method是否为给定目标类实例的属性访问候选项。

items.source: targetClass - the concrete target class that is being introspected
items.translation: targetClass - 正在被内省的具象目标类
